lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a series of four identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a regular 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a coordinate-like system where blobs serve as high-intensity anchor nodes within the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-to-low luminance gradient from the dorsal to ventral edge of the ridge, indicating a prominent structural carina.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 small, high-luminance blobs primarily distributed along the anterior base and the mid-section of the fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. A linear horizontal feature with disrupted pixel patterning is present on the posterior flank, ventral to the primary ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
